Find your stocking size.

Choose a method to check the ankle band, calf cut and length for a knee-high stocking.

Assisted video

    Use even light, a flat target and a fixed lens and zoom. Without the printed target in view, the video cannot be measured.

    Scrub to a sharp front or side frame. Pause and save each view to mark it.

    The printed scale rectangle must be visible in this frame, upright beside the leg. Its four outer corners are marked first. Measurements appear once both the front and side views are marked.

    LiDAR scan

    Uses the LiDAR sensor on iPhone 12 Pro or later Pro models to scan the lower leg in 3D. The ankle and calf circumference are measured from the scan, so no printed target is needed. Someone else holds the phone.

    Scanning rules

    • Stand, don’t sit. Barefoot, upright, weight on both feet, legs a little apart. A bent or seated leg is refused.
    • A helper holds the phone. You cannot scan all the way round your own leg.
    • Bare the leg to the knee and use even, bright light.
    • Go all the way round: front, sides, behind the calf and between the legs, from the ankle up to the knee. A scan from one side comes out flat and is refused.
    • Move slowly at arm’s length, and keep some floor in view all round the foot.
    • Check before exporting: rotate the model in the app. Seen from above, the leg should look round, not like a flat ribbon. If not, scan again.
    • Scan each leg twice. Values are used only when two scans agree within 1 cm.

    Step by step with a free scanning app

    1. Measure the Length by tape: standing barefoot, from the floor to two finger widths below the knee crease. Enter it under Check a stocking size and choose the leg.
    2. The wearer stands barefoot on a clear floor, upright, legs a little apart, weight on both feet, leg bare to the knee.
    3. The helper opens the scanning app and starts a Mesh (LiDAR) scan. Begin at the floor beside the foot.
    4. Walk slowly all the way around the leg at arm’s length, including behind the calf and between the legs, sweeping from the ankle up to the knee.
    5. Finish and let the app process the scan. Rotate the model and check the leg is round from above. Crop to the one leg if the app allows, keeping the floor.
    6. Export the model as shown for your app below, and save it to Files.
    7. Refresh this page if needed, tap Upload the scan below, and choose the file.
    8. Scan and upload the same leg a second time. The ankle and calf are entered once two scans agree within 1 cm.
    Scaniverse (free, recommended)

    Choose a Mesh scan, not a Splat. After processing, tap Share, then Export Model, and choose OBJ or GLB. Do not use USDZ.

    3d Scanner App (free trial, then subscription)

    Use a LiDAR mode. After processing, tap Share or Export and choose OBJ (GLB, STL and PLY also work). Cancel the trial if you do not want it to renew.

    Polycam (free plan exports glTF only)

    Use LiDAR mode. Export as glTF. Upload the ZIP it makes, or select the .gltf and .bin files together. OBJ and other formats need a paid Polycam plan.

    Compression Fit iPhone app

    1. Choose the leg below. Stand barefoot on a clear floor, legs apart, weight on both feet.
    2. Tap Start LiDAR scan. Move the phone slowly over the floor beside the foot until the floor is found.
    3. From behind, tap the cuff point: two finger widths below the knee crease. The app measures the length from this point.
    4. Walk slowly all the way around the leg at arm’s length, sweeping from the ankle up to the knee, then tap Finish scan.
    5. Scan twice. The values are used once both scans agree within 1 cm.

    Check a stocking size

    Select a leg and enter its measurements in centimetres.

    1. Use a soft, non-stretch tape, or tap Print fitting tape and check its 10 cm line with a ruler.
    2. Choose the leg below. Measure each leg separately.
    3. Ankle: measure around the narrowest point just above the ankle bone.
    4. Calf: measure around the widest point of the calf.
    5. Length: stand barefoot with the foot flat, and measure from the floor to two finger widths below the crease behind the knee.
    6. Keep the tape snug and level, enter the three values in centimetres, and tap Find stocking size.

    Where to measure

    Ankle
    Measure around the narrowest point above the ankle bone.
    Calf
    Measure around the widest point.
    Length
    Stand barefoot with your foot flat. Measure from the floor to two finger widths below the crease behind the knee.

    A soft, non-stretch fabric tape also works. Keep it snug and level.

    Compression FitProduct sizing pilot

    Camera calibration target

    Print at actual size (100%). Use a ruler to check the rectangle is 100 mm wide and 150 mm high. Mount this page upright on a rigid flat surface.

    Knee-high stocking fitting tape

    Print at actual size (100%). Check the 10 cm line against a ruler. Cut out the two strips and butt the two 25 cm ends together. Tape the join on the back.

    Record each leg separately. Measure the narrowest ankle above the ankle bone, the widest calf, and the floor-to-cuff length.
